All objectives complete and verified.

## Final Report

**1. Ticket created — DONE**
Ticket titled `fwrd61-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**, customer Marlow Bakery), initial status Draft.

**2. Part A added — DONE**
`fwrd61-n1 RD Part A`, cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1 → computed price **$125.00**.

**3. Part B added — DONE**
`fwrd61-n1 RD Part B`, cost $200.00, markup 25%, qty 1 → computed price **$250.00**. (Parts total at that point: $375.00.)

**4. Part A cost changed to 150 — DONE**
Cost edited from 100 → 150, markup still 25% → computed price **$187.50**. (Parts total: $437.50.)

**5. Status set to Ready — DONE**
Precondition discovered: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier.** Clicking "Mark Ready" was initially refused with the verbatim alert:
> "Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd61-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier / Part "fwrd61-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"

I edited each part and set Supplier to "Acme Industrial Supply" (all other values unchanged), then "Mark Ready" succeeded. Final status shown on the page: **Ready**.

**6. Parts removed and ticket archived — DONE**
Both parts deleted via their Delete buttons (each confirmed through an in-page "Confirm" dialog with "Delete part"). The parts table settled to the empty state: "No parts on this ticket yet." Then "Archive ticket" was accepted immediately (no confirmation dialog, no preconditions); the button flipped to "Unarchive ticket" and an "Archived" badge appeared next to Status.

Verified afterwards: searching "fwrd61-n1" in the default active tickets list returns "No tickets match the current filters." — the ticket is absent from the active list. With "Show archived" ticked, it appears as the single row: `RD-1015 | fwrd61-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Marlow Bakery | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-16` (0 parts, status Ready, archived). Nothing created by this run remains active.
